Page number at top right.; One block of running text in one column, with a large woodcut initial E at the start of the first paragraph; no margin notes; a catchword-like signature word "Sathan" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: Either I am in an Apoplexie, or that man is in a Lethargie, who doth not now sensibly feel God shaking the Heavens over his head, and the Earth under his feet: The Heavens so, as the Sun begins to turne into darknesse, the Moon into blood, the Starres to fall down to the ground; So that little Light of Comfort or Counsell is left to the sonnes of men: The Earth so, as the foundations are failing, the righteous scarce know where to finde rest, the Inhabitants stagger like drunken men: It is in a manner dissolved both in Religions and Relations: And no marvell; for, they have defiled it by transgressing the Lawes, changing the Ordinances, and breaking the Everlasting Covenant. The Truths of God are the Pillars of the world, whereon States and Churches may stand quiet if they will; if they will not, He can easily shake them off into delusions, and distractions enough.

page.notes: A row of woodcut crown and fleur-de-lis ornaments lies between the rule and "THE"; it is not text. Faint show-through text in the right half of the page is not transcribed. The large initial E is a woodcut; the first word is "Either" with the E joined. The word "Sathan" at the lower right is a catchword-style signature line, not a heading.
